profile.headline: Software Engineer at Stealth Startup
profile.summary:
Simulation, Dynamics&Control, 3D Graphics & GPU expert worked on fluids, multibody dynamics simulation, geometry, and rendering; worked on various projects from research ideation, execution (by my self, interns, and/or university collaboration), tech transfer (worked with various engineering teams), and shipping with small or large impacts to existing products or new products in multiple platforms. 

Aerospace and Mathematics education backgrounds in dynamics & control, and numerical simulations. Addicted to learning new things - machine learning with cnn, crnn, and reinforcement learning; and hardware design and soldering STM32, FPGA, and sensor boards, and developing/debugging firmware and HDL.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed advanced robot simulators and force controllers with full dynamics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on heat simulation development for semiconductor heat transfer problem (finite element analysis).

positions.description: Worked on geometry processing both with traditional algorithm and neural network.

positions.title: Senior Research Scientist
positions.description: Worked as a researcher, executing innovation projects and delivering tech transfers, internal and external demos, as well as research papers.

positions.title: Senior System Software Engineer on 3D Graphics
positions.description:
Worked as a DirectX driver engineer, Enjoyed fixing complex bugs.
Implemented some driver-side overrides: SSAO and TrAA
